item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
Glad you liked it.
Remember:

You may like to think that everyone around you has a soul. They usually don't. Those who have souls are not mere carcasses, but people like you, people who experience reality. Those who have no souls…

They are like you! Except they are only carcass. Only body. Only processes and functions and atoms and electrons. Only emergent properties from the matter they are made of.

No consciousness.

No one there.

Nothing experiences anything in them.

The metaphor of the boat and the sailor are lost on them, for they are only vessel.

Because they are secretly empty.

item.title: Is it a Hippo? Is it a plane?
item.content:encoded:
